title: Graph search, step by step
summary: Step a greedy search through a small undirected graph, one visited node at a time, with an adjustable beam width.

accessibility.description: An undirected graph of twelve labelled nodes. The current node is outlined, visited nodes are filled, and the frontier is dashed.
accessibility.keyboard: Space takes one step. Shift+Space steps back. Up and down arrows change the beam width.
